messages:
pager-bot: [PAGER] 22:07 UTC - Increased error rate and token failures on /v1/chat (redwood-7B-quant) in us-east-1. Auto-page to #oncall and #incidents.

lee_oncall: picking this up. dashboards show p50 unchanged, p95 up from ~180ms -> 1.1s, 5xx rose to ~0.9%.

anita_ops: any recent infra or model profile rollouts?

lee_oncall: there was a quant profile QP-v3 rollout started at 21:55 UTC through the staged rollout pipeline. Also runtime 1.9.7 introduced a batching heuristic tweak earlier today.

drew_sre: logs show repeated kv cache misses and a few worker crashes with "kv_index_oob" followed by OOM-ish traces.

olivia_prodeng: traffic steady. my hunch: quantization + new batching heuristic causing batch grouping to change and exposing kv cache boundary bug.

tariq_support: we're receiving escalations from two Dedicated customers, both reporting intermittent 5xx and truncated responses. Opened tickets SUP-1204 and SUP-1205.

drew_sre: sample worker log:```\n[21:59:12] WARN kv_cache: unexpected entry count (expected 16, got 0)\n[21:59:12] ERROR runtime: kv_index_oob at kv_cache.cpp:312\n[21:59:19] INFO batching: grouped sequences: 36, max_seq=1536\n```

rachel_pm: flagging customer impact. If this persists >30m we need a comms update and possible SLA review.

lee_oncall: mitigation plan: A) pin affected tenants to redwood-7B-fp16 (non-quant) by routing rule B) reduce runtime.batching.max_group to 12 for quantized variants C) restart quantized workers to clear KV state. Applying A and B now.

pager-bot: routing change applied at 22:16 UTC for tenant set beta -> redwood-7B-fp16. Batching config set to runtime.batching.max_group=12 in us-east-1.

anita_ops: rolling restarts started for quant fleet; each worker restart flushes kv cache.

drew_sre: post-mitigation metrics: 5xx down to 0.05%, p99 back to ~380ms. Good.

lee_oncall: marking incident as mitigated at 22:20 UTC. leaving thread open for RCA & follow-ups.

olivia_prodeng: we'll need an RCA and a remediation plan. I'll lead the reproduction work.

rachel_pm: I'll coordinate customer follow-up and prepare an interim message for affected tenants. Tariq, can you compile logs and customer transcripts?

tariq_support: on it. attaching ticket excerpts to INF-7012.

drew_sre: initial root-cause hypothesis: QP-v3 introduced smaller per-token encoding which changed internal KV layout assumptions; combined with new batching heuristic creating larger consolidated effective sequence lengths, the KV cache index math overflowed for some long sequences, causing invalid accesses and crashes/5xx.

anita_ops: creating remediation tasks: RT-4701 (kv bounds checks + safe-fallback), RT-4702 (batching heuristic rollback + safety caps), QNT-2199 (add regression suite for QP-v3 long sequence traffic). Linking into INF-7012.

lee_oncall: handoff to anita_ops for deep RCA. I'll be available for questions.

--- ONCALL HANDOFF ---
anita_ops: taking over at 23:00 UTC. Status: mitigated, routing pinned for impacted tenants to fp16, hotfix plan drafted. Next: reproduce in staging with stress harness, run kv fuzzer, land hotfix with canary.

drew_sre: proposed hotfix: add bounds checks in kv lookup, and if a violation detected return a soft error (503) instead of crash. Also add metrics to count such events.

olivia_prodeng: schedule postmortem meeting: 2026-03-19 16:00 UTC (45m). Invite eng-runtime, eng-ml, eng-sre, support, product.

rachel_pm: confirmed. I'll prepare customer-impact slide: tenants affected, window of elevated errors (21:55-22:20 UTC), mitigation actions taken.

action items (created during triage):
- (owner: olivia_prodeng) Full repro harness and perf test for QP-v3 under long sequences and grouped batching. Due: 2026-03-25. Ticket: RT-4703.
- (owner: drew_sre) Implement kv-index bounds checks + soft-fail path. Unit tests + fuzzer. Due: 2026-03-22. Ticket: RT-4701.
- (owner: anita_ops) Add runtime metric alert: kv_index_oob_count > 0 or kv_cache_miss_rate > 0.5% for 3m -> paging. Due: 2026-03-18. Ticket: INF-7013.
- (owner: lee_oncall) Add rollout gating: QP-v3 cannot progress beyond 10% traffic unless p99 < 600ms for 15m. Due: 2026-03-21. Ticket: QNT-2200.
- (owner: tariq_support) Draft and send customer follow-up with timeline and next steps. Due: 2026-03-18. Ticket: SUP-1208.

anita_ops: adding short-term guard: set runtime.batching.max_group = 12 for all quantized profiles until hard fix. Will be deployed as hotfix with a rollback flag.

drew_sre: plan for tests: expand CI to simulate mixed batch grouping, long seq lengths (>=1536), and quantized model KV behaviors. Also add an integration canary that runs a small synthetic workload through QP-v3 for 30m.

olivia_prodeng: dev schedule: estimated timeline for full remediation 2 weeks for fix + tests, 3 weeks for canary and phased rollback. Prioritize RT-4701 and QNT-2199.

rachel_pm: postmortem owner: anita_ops. reviewer: drew_sre. Postmortem doc will be posted to /docs/postmortems and linked to INF-7012.

anita_ops: leaving status note for next oncall: "mitigated. hotfix queued and PR opened for kv bounds checks. batching cap applied. postmortem scheduled." Handoff at 08:00 UTC.

lee_oncall: thanks all. Closing live incident channel; follow-ups in INF-7012 and RT-4701.

tariq_support: uploaded support transcripts to INF-7012 and created SUP-1208 draft for review.

drew_sre: incident tracker updated with core dumps and worker ids.

anita_ops: incident-bot: please create linked tickets RT-4701, RT-4702, QNT-2199 and mark INF-7012 as postmortem_required.

pager-bot: created RT-4701, RT-4702, QNT-2199 and linked to INF-7012 at 23:38 UTC.

rachel_pm: final ask  ensure QP-v3 pipeline has a QA gate that simulates long sequence workloads before any rollout.

olivia_prodeng: acknowledged and adding to QP rollout checklist.

anita_ops: noting emoji reactions :thumbsup: :sparkles: throughout thread.
